setup.run: apt-get update -q >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -q nginx >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -q rsync >/dev/null 2>&1

adduser --quiet --disabled-password --comment 'Site deploys' deploy && install -d -o deploy -g deploy /var/www/ana.example && printf ' ana.example

Hello from ana.example

' > /var/www/ana.example/index.html && chown deploy:deploy /var/www/ana.example/index.html

setup: printf '192.0.2.10 ana.example   # stand-in for public DNS: ana.example is a documentation name\n' >> /etc/hosts

su - ana -c "mkdir ~/site && printf ' ana.example

Ana

I run my own server.

' > ~/site/index.html && printf ' About

About

' > ~/site/about.html"
su - ana -c "ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C ana@laptop -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh-keyscan -q -t ed25519 192.0.2.10 > ~/.ssh/known_hosts" && cat ~ana/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

setup.run: install -d -m 700 -o deploy -g deploy ~deploy/.ssh && install -m 600 -o deploy -g deploy /dev/stdin ~deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys

session:
cat > ~/deploy.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# deploy.sh: publish ~/site to ana.example
set -euo pipefail
trap 'echo "deploy.sh: failed at line $LINENO" >&2' ERR

site_dir="$HOME/site"
target="deploy@192.0.2.10:/var/www/ana.example/"

if [ ! -f "$site_dir/index.html" ]; then
    echo "deploy.sh: no $site_dir/index.html, nothing to deploy" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Deploying $site_dir to $target"
rsync -a --delete "$site_dir/" "$target"
echo "Done."
EOF
